name: Wood-Pressed Mustard Oil
subtitle: Mara Chekku extracted yellow mustard seed
description: Cold-pressed in slow-moving wooden Kolhus (Mara Chekku) below 38°C to retain natural pungency, essential allyl isothiocyanate, and heart-healthy monounsaturated fatty acids. Never refined, unbleached, and naturally settled.
benefits: Rich in natural omega-3 and alpha-linolenic acids
Traditional kacchi ghani cold-press below 38°C preserves live enzymes
Naturally aromatic with pungent golden mustard hue
Zero mineral oils, chemical preservatives, or hexanes
tasteNotes: Bold, nutty, traditional mustard warmth with a clean peppery finish
process: Sun-dried native yellow mustard seeds crushed in seasoned Vaagai wood pestles over 45 minutes.

name: Wild Forest Raw Honey
subtitle: Multi-floral nectar from Western Ghats canopies
description: Harvested ethically from wild Apis dorsata honeycombs high in the moist evergreen canopies of Wayanad. Unheated, micro-filtered through muslin cloth to preserve natural pollen, bee propolis, and live antioxidants.
benefits: 100% Raw and unheated — preserves active floral enzymes
Wild multi-floral nectar with medicinal bio-flavonoids
Ethically gathered without harming forest bee colonies
Bottled in UV-protective amber glass
tasteNotes: Complex caramel notes, forest wildflower sweetness, gentle herbal undertones
process: Crush-free gravity draining through natural organic muslin; zero sugar feeding or heating.

name: Heirloom Foxtail Millet (Kangni)
subtitle: Ancient climate-resilient unpolished grain
description: Naturally drought-hardy heirloom foxtail millets grown using traditional dryland rainfed methods. Only dehusked once to preserve 100% of the nutrient-dense fibrous bran layer and germ.
benefits: Low Glycemic Index (GI 54) for sustained blood sugar stability
High dietary fiber (8g per 100g) aids digestive microbiome
Rich in bioavailable iron, magnesium, and dietary zinc
Grown with 70% less water than white rice
tasteNotes: Earthy, subtly sweet, light fluffy texture when steamed or simmered
process: Traditional stone dehusking that retains natural golden pericarp and vitamin B matrix.

name: Stone-Ground Lakadong Turmeric
subtitle: High-potency organic root with 7.4% Curcumin
description: Cultivated in the mineral-rich soils of Jaintia Hills, Meghalaya. Ground on watermill-driven stone chakkis at cold temperatures to protect the volatile essential oils and extraordinary 7.4% natural curcumin content.
benefits: Certified 7.4% Curcumin content (vs 2-3% in standard turmeric)
Stone-ground at low RPM to prevent thermal oxidation
Pure single-origin root; zero artificial color or starch fillers
Potent cellular anti-inflammatory and antioxidant tonic
tasteNotes: Intense earthy fragrance, deep golden-orange hue, warm aromatic kick
process: Sun-dried rhizomes stone-pulverized slowly without thermal friction.

name: Speckled Stoneware Chai Mug
subtitle: Hand-thrown studio pottery with botanical leaf motif
description: Each mug is individually wheel-thrown from local iron-rich stoneware clay, hand-painted with an indigenous monsoon leaf brushwork, and high-fired at 1260°C for exceptional durability and tactile warmth.
benefits: High-fired stoneware retains beverage warmth longer
Ergonomic looped handle designed for mindful morning sipping
Food-safe, non-toxic, non-porous mineral glaze
Every piece bears slight organic variations of the potter’s hand
tasteNotes: Elevates everyday chai, filter coffee, or herbal infusions into a quiet ritual
process: Hand-shaped on potter’s wheel, bisque fired, glazed with natural wood-ash pigments, fired at Cone 6.

name: Cold-Pressed Virgin Sesame Oil
subtitle: Slow wood-churned with organic palm jaggery
description: Extracted from black sesame seeds using indigenous Vaagai wood presses with a hint of natural palm jaggery to moderate bitterness, as described in classical Ayurvedic texts.
benefits: Rich in sesamol and sesamolin — natural potent antioxidants
High smoke point suitable for traditional tempering and sauteing
Nourishing for bone density and joint lubrication
tasteNotes: Deep nutty fragrance with a delicate caramelized sesame sweetness
process: Wood-churned extraction with heirloom unrefined palm jaggery.

name: Whole Tellicherry Black Peppercorns
subtitle: Extra-bold TGSEB grade vine-ripened berries
description: Vine-ripened until fully plump, hand-picked and sun-dried on bamboo mats in the misty Western Ghats. Extra-bold 4.75mm berries offering unmatched piperine intensity and citrus florals.
benefits: Contains 4.8% piperine for optimal turmeric curcumin absorption
Whole berries lock in volatile essential aromatic terpenes
Grown in biodiverse shade under native silver oak trees
tasteNotes: Pungent, woodsy heat balanced by crisp eucalyptus and citrus aromas
process: Shade-grown, hand-harvested at peak maturity, sun-cured naturally.

name: The Monsoon Harvest Gift Box
subtitle: Curated artisanal pantry staples & ceramic keepsake
description: Our signature gifting collection: Wild Forest Honey (350g), Wood-Pressed Mustard Oil (500ml), Lakadong Turmeric (200g), and our hand-thrown Speckled Ceramic Chai Mug, packaged in an unbleached handmade kraft chest tied with natural jute string and dried botanicals.
benefits: Thoughtful, healthy corporate and festive celebration gift
Includes handwritten seed-paper gift card that blooms into marigolds
Supports four separate rural farmer and artisan communities
tasteNotes: The complete sensory experience of an organic Indian monsoon kitchen
process: Curated with zero single-use plastics in biodegradable reclaimed fiber boxes.
